en-US: Please try voice conversation startup and repeated turns, short and quiet phrases, stopping and restarting dictation, voice previews, speed and pitch controls, and table read-aloud. Also try Volcengine search and configuration sync. Enhanced recognition models stay loaded after first foreground use and release under background or memory pressure.
